title: Reconstructing six months from half-memory
html_title: How I Prepare a Performance Review from Scattered Notes
post_summary: By the time I can write a performance review, I have usually reconciled the CRM data in Excel, searched six months of 1:1s, checked development plans and read the employee's self-review.
meta_description: How I prepare a performance review using CRM results, Excel, 1:1 notes, development plans, an employee self-review and the skills matrix.

featured_image.alt: Several work records, including results, 1:1 notes and development plans, being assembled into one performance review record.
